market_question: Will ByteDance have the highest IPO Market Cap 2026?
reasoning: ByteDance remains one of the world's most valuable private companies, and even a low probability of a 2026 IPO — given its scale — yields a meaningful chance of having the year's highest IPO market cap. The market's implied 0.1% probability seems excessively dismissive, likely due to regulatory overhang, but the true probability is still an order of magnitude higher.
evidence_points: ByteDance was valued at ~$220B in 2023-2024 secondary trades, indicating massive IPO potential.
Recent largest IPOs (e.g., ARM ~$54B) are dwarfed by ByteDance's valuation, so if it IPOs, it's likely to be the top.
Chinese tech IPO activity has been subdued but occasional large listings (e.g., Didi) show it's possible, and ByteDance has explored IPO plans before.
sources_consulted: SMIC and other large IPO data
General knowledge of Chinese tech regulatory environment
